normalized_text: @../nodex, @../hatel, @../symora도 참고해서 효과적으로 연동활용하고 있는지, 어설픈 휴리스틱이나 폴백, 패턴 매칭이 오탐이나 부작용을 유발하지 않는지, 네이밍과 컨벤션이 일관적인지, spec 기반 flywheel이 stale·중복·충돌로부터 안전한지도 함께 봐줘.
decision_text: A per-task review scope, not a standing constraint. Which sibling repositories a change must be read against is a fact about that change; installed as a rule it would make every review sweep three repositories the work may not touch. The spec-flywheel half does not apply here at all — this repository has no specs/ directory; it ships the pattern.

normalized_text: 어설픈 휴리스틱이나 폴백, 패턴 매칭 등으로 오탐이나 부작용이 있을 수 있는 임시적·단편적 처리는 아닌지 확인하고, 장기적 관점의 검증된 베스트프랙티스로 근본 원인을 해결하는 방향으로 진행해. 처음부터 이렇게 설계된 것처럼 클린하게, 변경에 대한 주석 없이 처리해.
decision_text: Already installed, and was in force when it was typed. All three clauses are in making-changes.md, which harness.toml lists as always-loaded: the heuristic clause at line 45 ('a principled solution to a special-case heuristic or a magic constant'), the fallback clause at 50 ('a silent fallback turns a loud bug into a quiet one'), and the clean-implementation clause at 69 ('as though it had always been this way ... no compatibility shim, dead branch, or used-to-be note'). This is a paragraph retyped into a session whose rules already carried it, which installation does not fix.

normalized_text: 최신 사실과 일치하는지뿐 아니라 불필요한 중복이나 장황함이 없는지, 분량이 최소로 압축됐는지도 함께 확인해.
decision_text: Covered by three existing owners. Currency is held by the twelve drift guards named in the measure-repeat decision; prose density in rule files by constitution VIII; record depth by making-changes.md ('depth follows blast radius'); rule length mechanically by [validate.rules] max_lines = 200. What remains uncovered is README verbosity, which has no mechanical test and would be a taste judgement written as a rule.

decision_text: One sighting, and the durable form is not yet clear: a reporting cadence for a long delegation depends on whether the runtime notifies on completion, in which case polling is waste. Kept surfacing rather than written as a rule off a single instance.
